site.heroTitle: Plans that go as far as your ideas.

everywhere.title: Everywhere
everywhere.text: Use it in the browser, install it as an app, or download it for Windows and Linux.

apps.intro: OS_Planner runs in your browser. Install it as an app, or download the desktop version for Windows or Linux. Your notes are the same everywhere.
apps.browserText: Nothing to install. Sign in on any device.
apps.pwaText: Adds OS_Planner to your apps with its own window, and keeps working offline.
apps.alreadyInstalled: You are using the installed app.
apps.justInstalled: Installed. Look for OS_Planner among your apps.

how.windows: In Chrome or Edge, open the browser menu and choose “Install OS_Planner” (or use the install icon in the address bar).
how.linux: In Chrome, Chromium or Edge, open the browser menu and choose “Install OS_Planner”. Firefox does not support installing web apps: use the desktop download below.
how.mac: In Safari choose File › Add to Dock. In Chrome or Edge choose “Install OS_Planner” from the browser menu.
how.android: Open the browser menu and tap “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
how.ios: Tap the Share button, then “Add to Home Screen”.
how.other: Open your browser menu and look for “Install” or “Add to Home screen”.

apps.desktopText: A native window for Windows and Linux. It loads the same website, so it is always up to date, and it keeps working offline.

apps.smartscreen: Windows may show a “SmartScreen” warning the first time, because the installer is not code-signed. Choose “More info” › “Run anyway”.
